headline: Tibo confirms a Tuesday reset
sourceTimezone: Unspecified; interpreted as Pacific daylight time (PDT, UTC−7)
originalTimeText: a reset for Tuesday; earlier: 3am on a tuesday
scope: Tibo has explicitly confirmed a reset for Tuesday, September 22. The 10:00 UTC countdown remains an editorial estimate based on his earlier “3am on a tuesday” reply interpreted as PDT.

announcement.text: Ladies and gentlemen... start... your... ENGINES. We are almost Tuesday and I promised a reset for Tuesday. Among some other things. See you soon.
announcement.translation: 女士们、先生们……启动你们的引擎。马上就是周二了，我答应过周二会进行一次重置。还有其他一些事情。很快见。

note: The Tuesday date is now explicit, but the exact time and reset format are not. The countdown keeps the earlier 3 AM clue and interprets it as San Francisco local time (PDT, UTC−7), producing 10:00 UTC. The latest post says only “a reset,” so CRW does not label it as a confirmed banked reset.
